target.title: [codex] Redesign analytics dashboard
target.body:
## Summary

- replace the visual-heavy hero and radial meters with a data-first analytics dashboard while preserving the Patchboard visual system
- add accessible 30-day request and provider-distribution charts with keyboard, touch, responsive, light, and dark behavior
- rebuild Usage as a full-width analytics and audit workspace
- add optional UTC daily usage buckets without changing existing rolling 30-day summary, provider, or event semantics
- preserve honest mixed-version rollout behavior by withholding trends until every usage shard supports daily buckets

## Before / after

### Dashboard

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Dashboard before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawrouter/bb503a0342aae00ef36848852776b15173454f7c/docs/redesign/analytics-before-home.png) | ![Dashboard after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawrouter/bb503a0342aae00ef36848852776b15173454f7c/docs/redesign/analytics-after-home.png) |

### Usage

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Usage before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawrouter/bb503a0342aae00ef36848852776b15173454f7c/docs/redesign/analytics-before-usage.png) | ![Usage after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawrouter/bb503a0342aae00ef36848852776b15173454f7c/docs/redesign/analytics-after-usage.png) |

## Usage semantics

- summaries, provider totals, and recent events retain the existing rolling 30-day cutoff
- chart buckets cover the latest 30 UTC dates independently of those rolling totals
- mixed legacy/current shards omit `daily` instead of rendering incomplete trend data
- admin and user demo series are generated from their own scoped summaries, so chart and headline totals agree

## Behavior proof

- desktop Dashboard and Usage rendered at 1280px with matching before/after captures
- 800px tablet header remained 57px tall; all six navigation items remained visible; document width matched viewport width
- 390px light and dark layouts remained readable with no document-level horizontal overflow
- chart keyboard inspection moved from July 6 (`73 requests`) to July 5 (`60 requests`) with ArrowLeft
- dark theme and `/dashboard/usage` route persisted across reload
- unavailable or empty daily trends remain visibly unavailable and non-interactive

## Validation

- `pnpm check` — 30 Worker, 23 admin, and 43 script tests passed
- `pnpm build` — provider compile, production admin bundle, Worker TypeScript, and Worker tests passed
- `git diff --check` passed
- final structured autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings

## Deployment

Not deployed; pending exact-head CI and merge.
